title: People who impressed him most: Tatum, Lester, Hawkins, Bird, Louis, Billie
summary: He names the musicians he admired for dedication and sound, including Art Tatum, Coleman Hawkins, Charlie Parker, Louis Armstrong and Billie Holiday.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: O.K. I think I want to ask one more question before we wind this reel up. Over the course of your life in the music business, what individuals have most impressed you, as people, maybe as people and as musicians?
Well, Art Tatum, because of his genius and his dedication to his art form. Lester

Young, dedicated to his art form. And, as far as saxophone players are concerned, Coleman Hawkins, because of his overall knowledge of music and his life-style. You know what I mean, as far as takin' care of himself, wearing good clothes and eating properly and getting his rest, you know, and having the best that life has to offer. That impressed me, you know. And then I admired Bird for his dedication, in spite of all the suffering and what not that he went through in his life. He still played pretty. And then, of course, Louis. Louis, you know, he was loved throughout the world. His sound. I admired him so much, you know. In fact I never heard a sound that golden on any instrument. When Louis hit a note, it went right through you. When he tuned up, when he hit "A" it went through you to your toes. And you felt it. And I admired Billy Holiday, because she seems to transfix people with her soul and her choice of material, you know what I mean.
